Artificial Analysis Decision Index

Weighted average of the Decision Score on AA-Paperclip, EvalSafe-O*NET-AA, When2Call, AA-Omniscience-Decision v1.1, and HLE-MultiChoice v1.1, and the Symmetry Score on AA-Symmetry v1.1 · Accuracy less the Brier score of the chosen answer's probability, from 0 to 100 where 100 is certain and right · Higher is better
